title: Constant velocity magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the velocity after the acceleration phase as 0.4 m/s.

title: Deceleration acceleration value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the deceleration acceleration as -0.2 m/s² (or 0.2 m/s² downward).

title: Acceleration phase calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply v = a*t to find the velocity after the initial 4-second acceleration.

title: Deceleration kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly use a = (v_f - v_i)/Δt with v_f = 0 and v_i = constant velocity.

title: Sign interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The student should interpret the negative sign in the deceleration answer as indicating downward acceleration.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student maintains consistent units (m/s and m/s²) throughout the solution.

title: Incorrect time usage
description: Pitfall Criteria: Using the total 48-second anthem duration instead of the specific 4-second and 2-second intervals for calculations.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: Calculating the deceleration magnitude as positive 0.2 m/s² without indicating direction or sign.
